centre.name: Alcare Place
centre.address: 1374 Robie St, Halifax, NS B3H 3E2, Canada

about_blocks.text: Alcare Place is a non-profit organization dedicated to the rehabilitation of addicted persons who have created a commitment to recovery. We’ve proven time and once more, since we opened our doors in February 1987, that it is attainable to rehabilitate addicted folks who are harmfully involved with alcohol, medication or gambling. Over the years, many individuals have entered our doors with a want to rebuild their lives and learn additional about awareness & prevention of dependence issues. After taking part in the Alcare Place Treatment Program, our clients come back to their communities as productive, contributing family members and citizens. Alcare Place provides a stable, safe and supportive atmosphere in that our program participants are able to focus their energies toward amendment and growth. Alcare Place can facilitate 13 clients and is supervised 24-hours a day. We are open to folks with dependence problems aged nineteen and over who are looking for a contemporary begin in life. As rehab from dependence is a multi-faceted, long-term method, solely those that show a commitment to recovery will be considered to attend our program. The common length of stay is five months, although it is not uncommon for clients to stay up to a year. Program participation and progress is monitored by usual case reviews.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
